label: main season
summary: Recommend further non-technical survey. E1–E3 support absence and no direct or target indirect evidence is reported, but cancellation criteria are not met: only E2 reports at least five years of safe use; E1 reports four years. The team observed paths and field edges, not the full area. The coded rule check passes.
flags: The nearest recorded past landmine accident is within 1 km, not stated to be inside this area; it does not trigger the dossier's inside-area clearance rule.
The zone-survey flag and zone priority are visit-planning information, not evidence about the area.
The team observation covered paths and field edges; further NTS should clarify safe-use coverage across the full forested area.

checks.detail: Further non-technical survey is always open.

E1.quote: We have walked the trail across this land to the school for 4 years. Nobody has found anything, and nobody has been hurt.
E1.note: The teacher personally uses the trail and reports four years without finds or injuries, supporting absence; this is first-hand land-use information.

E2.quote: the board has recorded no find or accident in the area in the 24 years she has held the post, and that families use land in the area every week.
E2.note: The community board president reports long-term local use and no recorded finds or accidents, supporting absence as a first-hand source.

E3.quote: The survey team walked the paths and field edges of the area and saw no items, signs, fencing or other marks of contamination.
E3.note: The survey team's own observation found no signs of contamination in the areas it walked, supporting absence.
